title: Nano Banana Pro
summary: Generate image with Nano Banana Pro
description: Google Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) — professional asset production with advanced reasoning, precise instruction-based editing, and multi-reference composition from up to 9 reference images. Billing: 120 credits per image at 1K/2K, 180 at 4K.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate.

reference_images.description: Optional reference images (up to 9) for image editing and multi-reference composition. Each item is a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Omit for text-to-image.

size.description: Output resolution tier. 1K/2K bill 120 credits per image; 4K bills 180.
